issues.title: Let members pick a reminder time
issues.body: Some members would like the reminder in the evening instead of at night.

issues.title: Allow a second renewal
issues.body:
## Context
Members keep asking for one more renewal on long books. ADR 0003 already allows two renewals per loan; the code still stops at one (`MAX_RENEWALS` in `src/loans.js`), so it is out of date with the ADR.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A loan with no hold waiting can be renewed twice; a third renewal is refused with reason `renewal-limit`.
- [ ] A waiting hold still blocks every renewal (ADR 0002).
